name: r3a1-related-both-directions
description: R3a-1 Outcome 2 cross-source relation contract: the workspace `knowvault_related` MCP tool and its shared relation core must return both directions of a relation — the objects the addressed object references (direction `references`) and the documents that reference the addressed object (direction `referencing`) — every hit carrying the related object's immutable address (source, version, object and span hash), its version and its moment. internal/platform/workspaceapi/mcp_related.go's mcpRelatedDirection resolves the closed direction vocabulary; the `referencing`, `references` and `both` members are all accepted. Dropping `references` (or `referencing`) from that case list makes the corresponding direction return -32602 instead of the relation page, which is a compilable behavioural regression, not a vacuous one. internal/platform/workspaceapi/mcp_related_test.go TestMCPRelatedReturnsBothDirectionsWithAddressVersion calls the tool once per direction and requires the served hit to carry the version, moment and full address (span text_hash and object fragment_id), so it kills either weakened direction. The anchor occurs exactly once in mcp_related.go.
baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree mcpRelatedDirection accepts `referencing`, `references` and `both`, so a call naming either direction is forwarded to the authorized relation source and returns the relation page with each hit's relation kind, excerpt, version, moment and immutable address; TestMCPRelatedReturnsBothDirectionsWithAddressVersion passes both directions with the address/version assertions.
mutant_meaning: With `references` dropped the `references` call is rejected with -32602 before the relation source is touched, so the test's references case fails (RED); with `referencing` dropped the `referencing` call is rejected and the test's referencing case fails (RED). Both mutants still compile and fail behaviourally, so the guard is killed by the registered probe and is not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.r3a1.related.cross-source-both-directions`; the identical cases are committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
